title: Toward Robust Medical Fairness: Debiased Dual-Modal Alignment via Text-Guided Attribute-Disentangled Prompt Learning for Vision–Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring discrepancies in medical image classification performance across sex groups using fairness metrics, specifically the difference in equalized odds (DEOdds) and demographic parity difference (DPD), on datasets like HAM10000, PAPILA, Harvard-GF3300, and chest X-rays.

Measuring discrepancies in medical image classification performance across racial and ethnic groups using the difference in equalized odds (DEOdds) and demographic parity difference (DPD) on datasets like Harvard-GF3300, CheXpert, and MIMIC-CXR.

Evaluating diagnostic disparities across different skin tones by computing the difference in equalized odds (DEOdds) and demographic parity difference (DPD) across Fitzpatrick skin types using the Fitzpatrick17k dermatology dataset.
